CREATE TABLE "tools" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "workspace" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE ("workspace", "name")
)

CREATE TABLE "builds" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "manifest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "changelog" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE ("tool_id", "fingerprint")
)

CREATE TABLE "versions" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "build_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "builds" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "version" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE ("tool_id", "version")
)

CREATE TABLE "environments" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("name" IN ('preview', 'pilot', 'production')),
  "branch" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "version_id" TEXT REFERENCES "versions" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
  "url" TEXT,
  "activated_at" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE ("tool_id", "name", "branch")
)

CREATE TABLE "approvals" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "versions" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "resource" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  "requested_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "decided_by" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TEXT,
  UNIQUE ("version_id", "resource")
)
CREATE INDEX "versions_by_tool" ON "versions" ("tool_id")
CREATE INDEX "environments_by_tool" ON "environments" ("tool_id")
CREATE INDEX "approvals_by_status" ON "approvals" ("tool_id", "status")
ALTER TABLE "builds" ADD COLUMN "worker" TEXT
ALTER TABLE "builds" ADD COLUMN "migrations" TEXT
ALTER TABLE "environments" ADD COLUMN "pilot_group" TEXT

CREATE TABLE "deployments" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "environment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "environments" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "versions" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("kind" IN ('deploy', 'promote', 'rollback')),
  "actor" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX "deployments_by_environment" ON "deployments" ("environment_id")

CREATE TABLE "secrets" (
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "environment" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("environment" IN ('preview', 'pilot', 'production')),
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "iv" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ciphertext" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("tool_id", "environment", "name")
)

CREATE TABLE "connections" (
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "environment" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("environment" IN ('preview', 'pilot', 'production')),
  "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "connector" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "scopes" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" TEXT,
  "iv" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ciphertext" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("tool_id", "environment", "user_id", "connector")
)

CREATE TABLE "audit_log" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tool_id" TEXT,
  "actor" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "interface" TEXT,
  "via" TEXT,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("kind" IN ('action', 'deployment', 'promotion', 'rollback', 'approval')),
  "subject" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "version_id" TEXT,
  "result" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("result" IN ('ok', 'denied', 'error')),

)
CREATE INDEX "audit_log_by_tool" ON "audit_log" ("tool_id", "at")

CREATE TABLE "role_access" (
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "tools" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "role" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "action" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "allowed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed" IN (0, 1)),

  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "seats" (
  "workspace" TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "members" (
  "workspace" TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "cli_codes" (

)

CREATE TABLE "gateway_code" (

)

CREATE TABLE "group_members" (
  "workspace" TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "token_revocations" (

CREATE INDEX "token_revocations_person" ON "token_revocations" ("workspace", "person")

CREATE TABLE "user_secrets" (
  "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "audit_log_next" (

INSERT INTO "audit_log_next" SELECT "id", "at", "tool_id", "actor", "interface", "via", "kind", "subject", "version_id", "result", "detail" FROM "audit_log" ORDER BY "rowid"
DROP TABLE "audit_log"
ALTER TABLE "audit_log_next" RENAME TO "audit_log"
CREATE INDEX "audit_log_by_tool" ON "audit_log" ("tool_id", "at")

CREATE TABLE "identity_providers" (
  "workspace" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
